Gozu (Japanese: ゴズ Gozu) is a recurring character in . He is a member of Team Rocket, being part of the elite unit known as the Matori Matrix.

==History==
 
Gozu first appeared in Filling the Light with Darkness!, where he and the rest of the Matori Matrix were sent to the Alola region by . He was first seen aboard a helicopter alongside Matori as it approached Alola. At that moment, Giovanni contacted them for a briefing on their progress. After Matori completed the call, she asked Gozu if they would arrive in Alola soon, and when he confirmed that they would, she had him give the order to activate their craft's cloaking device.

In Full Moon and Many Arms!, the Matori Matrix arrived in Alola, but were left lethargic due to draining Ultra Aura from the adults around the region. Despite this, when they encountered Necrozma in its form, they managed to trap it inside an electrified net before it shortly broke out. The unit briefly retreated, only to return and attack and Nebby using laser cannons on their aircraft while the pair recuperated on the beach of Melemele Island. They ensnared Lunala and Nebby in another electrified net, but it was soon destroyed by Gladion's Silvally and Ash's Pikachu. Nebby retaliated by hitting the aircraft with , forcing them to retreat again. Later, after Necrozma possessed Nebby, turned into , and fled through an Ultra Wormhole, Gozu and the rest of the unit were rejuvenated and continued their mission.

In The Prism Between Light and Darkness!, Gozu and the rest of the Matori Matrix witnessed the Ultra Guardians and Lunala head inside an Ultra Wormhole and attempted to pursue them, only to be stopped by and . Gozu, along with several s, headed down to Ten Carat Hill to face the duo. There, Gozu used his to easily defeat Kukui's and Faba's and .

In Securing the Future!, Professor Kukui was able to defeat Gozu's Aggron with . Upon learning that repairs to the aircraft were complete, he returned there and had it head into the Ultra Wormhole. However, the aircraft was attacked by , forcing the Matori Matrix to retreat.

==Character==
Gozu is a very serious and competent person. However, he tends to wear an eyepatch over his right eye, despite the fact that there is nothing physically wrong with said eye. Gozu also has a very close bond with his , allowing it to Mega Evolve. In addition, he has a rational mindset; in The Prism Between Light and Darkness!, he knew better than to pursue the Ultra Guardians through the Ultra Wormhole after the airship had been damaged.
